# Simulation run configuration — flags, defaults, and why

Derived from `scratch/mptd_pqs_sdvn/`. 86 CLI flags found in `12_main.h`.

## The canonical run

This is the configuration that produced the currently reported D1/D4/D6 results.

```bash
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$NS3/build/lib
cd $NS3
$BIN --mobility_source=1 --mobility_scenario=0 --maxspeed=60 \
     --N_Vehicles=200 --N_RSUs=64 \
     --attack_number=0 --attack_percentage=40 --simTime=300 \
     --ablation_mode=0 --routing_test=false \
     --skip_blockchain=true --per_pid_results=1 \
     --enable_gat=1 --enable_lstm_ae=1 --seed=1 \
     --per_rsu_vehicle_state=1 --ring_detect=1 \
     --gat_det_flag_heads=0 --psi_cond_floor=1 \
     > $SCRATCH/<dir>/<arm>.log 2>&1 &
```

| arm | flags |
|---|---|
| D1 (no ML) | `--enable_gat=0 --enable_lstm_ae=0` |
| D4 (GAT only) | `--enable_gat=1 --enable_lstm_ae=0` |
| D6 (GAT + LSTM-AE) | `--enable_gat=1 --enable_lstm_ae=1` |

**Verify before every run:**

```bash
# 1. deployed model must be the ORIGINAL (the Fix-A model is a known dead end)
cd $NS3/analytics/ml/models/urban_combined
readlink gat_model.onnx     # EXPECT: ../urban/gat_model.onnx
cat theta_s.txt             # EXPECT: 19.74
cat theta_ae.txt            # EXPECT: 33.693885

# 2. binary is current
cd $NS3 && ./waf build --targets=mptd_pqs_sdvn

# 3. after launching, confirm the flags that ACTUALLY reached the process
for p in <pids>; do tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline; echo; done
```

## Traps — read before running anything

| trap | detail |
|---|---|
| `routing_test` defaults **true** | Declared in `07_socket_layer.h:16`, not in any config header -- which is why it stayed invisible. Always pass `--routing_test=false`. |
| `ablation_mode` defaults **1** | Mode 1 = AB1, not full mode. Always pass `--ablation_mode=0`. |
| `gat_det_flag_heads` defaults **46**, not 0 | The OR-path is ON unless you explicitly pass `--gat_det_flag_heads=0`. Reported runs pass 0. |
| ns-3 CLI booleans | Need `=0`/`=1`, not bare flags. A bare `--ring_detect` does not enable it. |
| `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` | Must be `build/lib` or the ONNX sessions fail to load. |
| log case sensitivity | `full_anom=YES` / `full_anom=no` -- case differs between the two outcomes. |
| `pgrep -f` / `pkill -f` self-match | The pattern matches your own shell. Use explicit PIDs. |
| dict-keyed log parsing | Keying on `(rsu,t,vid)` silently dedups and has twice produced results contradicting the simulator. Add an occurrence index and validate the parsed confusion matrix against the simulator's printed `MCC_full` before trusting any analysis. |
| theta_S must come from **in-sim** clean p95 | Never the offline corpus. Offline 3.709 vs in-sim 41.46; using the offline value collapsed MCC to 0.20. |
| `rsu_window.anomalous[]` has ZERO readers | Writing to it does nothing. Fusion reads `psi`, so flags must be set BEFORE psi is computed (~`08_detection_engine.h:2288`), not after. |
| `--per_pid_results=1` when running arms concurrently | Isolates each run's `analytics/results_pid<PID>/`. Without it, per-beacon logs collide -- `a4_p40_m0` was once found to contain all of `a3_p40_m0`. |
| `stealthy_control_plane` defaults **true** | Declared `02_config_globals.h:221`. Never passed on any reported run, so TP-S3/MP-S4 were in STEALTH mode throughout. Not a bug, but it is an unstated experimental condition. |

## Flags in the reported runs

| flag | default | set to | why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--N_RSUs` | `4` | `64` | 8x8 grid at 250 m spacing; matches `tab:set-network`. |
| `--N_Vehicles` | `16` | `200` | Fleet size for the reported scenario; matches `tab:set-network`. |
| `--N_Controllers` | `4` | `4 (DEFAULT — never passed)` | Size of the registered controller set C. Relevant to the Eq 3.69 controller-quorum work: the SC-Revoke floor refuses an exclusion that would empty C_trusted, and with 4 controllers all four were once excluded in epoch E7 before that floor existed. |
| `--data_transmission_frequency` | `10.0` | `10.0 (DEFAULT)` | Beacon rate in Hz — 10 Hz = the 100 ms interval T_b assumed throughout the paper. Changing it invalidates every per-beacon threshold and the N_b/detection-feasibility derivation. |
| `--link_lifetime_threshold` | `0.400` | `0.400 (DEFAULT)` | Routing link-lifetime cutoff, calibrated for the 270 m DSRC range. Affects the routing plane only, not detection. |
| `--simTime` | `15.0` | `300` | Full duration. NOTE: ordering D1<D4<D6 holds at a 90 s cutoff but NOT over the full 300 s -- see the audit. |
| `--mobility_scenario` | `0` | `0` | 0 = urban (Shinjuku). 1 = rural, 2 = highway. |
| `--architecture` | `0` | `0 (DEFAULT)` | Network architecture variant selector. 0 is the standard three-plane SDVN layout used for all reported results. |
| `--maxspeed` | `60` | `60` | Urban regime speed. Distinct from `--s_max_kmh`, which is the DETECTOR bound. |
| `--lambda` | `10` | `10 (DEFAULT)` | Routing/link parameter. NOT the fusion weights lambda_1..3 — those come from fusion_weights.json and are set via --lambda_gat/--lambda_ae. Name collision; do not confuse them. |
| `--delta_hmac` | `0.5` | `0.5 (DEFAULT)` | H5 Delta_HMAC beacon freshness window, seconds. A beacon whose timestamp is staler than this is rejected by LW-DETECT before signature scoring. |
| `--delta_trs` | `2.0` | `2.0 (DEFAULT)` | H6 Delta_TRS freshness window for sigma_TRS verification (Eq 3.53). Inert while --skip_blockchain=true. |
| `--attack_number` | `1` | `0` | 0 = COMBINED mode, all seven variants active at once. Any other value runs a single variant. |
| `--stealthy_control_plane` | `true` | `true (DEFAULT — never passed on the command line)` | Active in every reported run by default. TP-S3/MP-S4 inject small plausible controller falsification that the beacon detectors cannot see; only CP-DETECT catches them. Pass `=false` for the legacy LOUD variant. The paper must state which mode produced its results. |
| `--experiment_number` | `0` | `0 (DEFAULT)` | Experiment selector for the Exp1-Exp5 harness; 0 = plain run, which is what the reported detection results use. |
| `--routing_test` | `true` | `false` | Must be forced off; the default is true and silently invalidates results. |
| `--routing_algorithm` | `0` | `0 (DEFAULT)` | Routing protocol selector. Inert for detection runs — meaningful only when --routing_test=true. |
| `--qf` | `0` | `0 (DEFAULT)` | Queue/flow parameter for the routing plane. Inert for detection runs. |
| `--attack_percentage` | `40` | `40` | rho_a = 0.40, the default high-stress point. Measured beacon-level poisoning at this setting is 79.16%, not the 89.6% quoted in paper item P3. |
| `--rsu_seed` | `0` | `0 (DEFAULT — never passed)` | 0 does NOT mean non-reproducible here: when --seed>0 the RSU compromise RNG is derived as run_seed*2654435761+12345 (06a_attack_models.h:558), so the compromised-RSU set is deterministic at --seed=1. It only falls back to the system clock if --seed is also unset. Pass --rsu_seed=N to pin the RSU set independently of the run seed. |
| `--seed` | `1` | `1` | Unified ns-3 RngRun + attack randomness. Vary for mean+/-std across seeds. |
| `--sybil_registration_pct` | `0` | `0 (DEFAULT — never passed)` | ⚠️ 0 selects the ORIGINAL Sybil mode, where ghost IDs sit OUTSIDE the registered pool. The code's own comment (02_config_globals.h:155-163) says detection is then "trivial" and "metrics are flat at 1.0 regardless of attack_percentage", and recommends 30-50 for meaningful variation. MP-S1/MP-S2 results and the ring_detect ghost-recall figure were all obtained in this easy mode. |
| `--ablation_mode` | `1` | `0` | Full scoring. Ablation is done by zeroing COMPONENTS (`--enable_gat/--enable_lstm_ae`), never by switching the simulator to a lightweight mode. This is the distinction between a valid ablation and a broken pipeline. |
| `--psi_cond_floor` | `false` | `1` | Floors attack-conditioned psi at the global-weight psi: psi_fuse = max(s, s_global). Prevents k_hat misrouting from ERASING rule evidence. Measured effect: D4's true-positive losses vs D1 went from 158 to ZERO. D1 is provably unaffected (k_hat < 0 there, so the floor is a no-op). |
| `--ring_detect` | `false` | `1` | Deterministic Sybil-ring geometry test. Ghost recall 0.49 -> 0.99 at zero FP cost, MCC +0.19. Fires through the MP-S1 signature bit, so it lifts ALL arms equally -- which is why it compresses the ablation ordering. |
| `--per_rsu_vehicle_state` | `false` | `1` | Fix B. Binds every vehicle_state access to the receiving RSU so an impersonator cannot contaminate the victim's kinematic history at a different RSU. Measured: vid98 FPR 1.0000 -> 0.0691, MCC +0.032. |
| `--honest_mp_s1` | `false` | `false (DEFAULT — never passed)` | MP-S1 ghost injection behaves adversarially, not honestly. Diagnostic control for isolating MP-S1's FP contribution. |
| `--uniform_speed_trace` | `false` | `false (DEFAULT — never passed)` | Trace keeps its natural SUMO speed distribution. Set true for Experiment 2, where every vehicle must travel at exactly the target speed. |
| `--mitm_stealth` | `false` | `false (DEFAULT — never passed)` | MP-S3 ran non-stealth. Paired with --faithful_mitm as the a6 MitM variants. |
| `--faithful_mitm` | `false` | `false (DEFAULT — never passed)` | MP-S3 (attack 6) ran in the default MitM mode, not the faithful variant added in commit dad4bc6. |
| `--per_pid_results` | `false` | `1` | Isolates each concurrent arm's results directory. Essential when D1/D4/D6 run in parallel. |
| `--enable_gat` | `-1` | `0 or 1` | Selects the arm. GAT off => S_i = 0, k_hat = -1, OR-flag off, and lambda_gat is dropped from the fusion sum and the survivors renormalised. |
| `--enable_lstm_ae` | `-1` | `0 or 1` | Selects the arm. AE off => eps_i = 0 and lambda_ae dropped + renormalised, identically to the GAT path. |
| `--gat_det_flag_heads` | `46` | `0` | DISABLES the GAT head OR-path entirely. Default is 46 (on). Beacons flagged only via this path were 54-55% of D4/D6 false positives for 285/306 true positives -- a poor exchange. Note this means paper item G4's Phi floor had nothing to act on. |
| `--skip_blockchain` | `false` | `true` | Detection runs do not need the Fabric round-trip. Turn OFF for the RQ5/RQ6 crypto-latency runs. |
| `--mobility_source` | `0` | `1` | Drive mobility from the SUMO trace rather than an ns-3 mobility model. |
| `--rsu_positions_csv_override` | `""` | `unset for the canonical run; only E3 (scalability sweep) sets it for N_Vehicles=300/400/500` | Default RSU coverage file (rsu_positions_urban.csv) is a fixed 64-RSU grid (supervisor-mandated 2026-06-12). E3 sweeps N_RSUs up to 160, which the file does not cover; without this override the simulator silently falls back to a broken legacy hardcoded grid with zero DSRC coverage on the real urban map (12_main.h ~1088-1107). Points at a separate place_rsus.py-generated CSV (mobility/e3_scalability/rsu_positions_urban_n{96,128,160}.csv, 100% coverage) instead, without touching the shared default file used by every other experiment. |
| `--mobility_trace_csv_override` | `""` | `unset for the canonical run; only E3 (scalability sweep) sets it for N_Vehicles=300/400/500` | Default mobility trace (mobility_urban_60.tcl) only has 200 vehicle trajectories. E3 sweeps N_Vehicles up to 500, which the trace does not cover; without this override nodes beyond 199 get no MobilityModel and the simulator aborts inside LteHelper::InstallUeDevice() (12_main.h ~584-600). Points at a separately generated trace (mobility/mobility_urban{300,400,500}_60.tcl, built via sumo/build_sumo_trace.sh with VEH_COUNT_OVERRIDE, same road network, KEEP_IN so vehicles never despawn) instead, without touching the shared default trace used by every other experiment. Also required bumping total_size 256->550 and MAX_NODES 320->600 (02_config_globals.h) since those are fixed compile-time array capacities sized for the old 200-vehicle ceiling. |

## Flags deliberately NOT used

| flag | default | why not used | when it SHOULD be used |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--verbose_tx` | `false` | Per-beacon [DSRC-TX]/[LL-SEL] stdout. Off because it bloats long runs -- the 300 s logs are already ~600 MB per arm without it. | Short debug runs only. |
| `--sybil_gat_evasive` | `false` | Scatters ghosts onto distinct spread-out RSU cells to evade density detection, instead of the clustered ring. | Adversarial-robustness testing of ring_detect -- the geometry test assumes a co-located ring, so this is its natural stressor and has NOT been run against it. |
| `--ghost_batch` | `false` | Built and never used in any reported run. Batches a ghost ring into ONE GAT window (N=4-5) instead of the standard window. | Required if paper item S3 is to be published as written -- S3 currently describes behaviour that was OFF. Enable and re-run, or reword S3. |
| `--ghost_ae` | `false` | Extends LSTM-AE temporal scoring to ghost identities. Deliberately off: ghosts have no genuine kinematic history to reconstruct against. | Only if ghost temporal modelling is added as a contribution. |
| `--hmac_fail_closed` | `false` | Changes HMAC failure from scoring to hard rejection. | AB2 / MitM experiments. |
| `--identity_binding` | `false` | ❌ **BROKEN** — Fix 1. Rejects beacon writes when the transmitter does not own the claimed ID. Measured -0.124 MCC with 40% of rejections falling on honest vehicles. Superseded by `--per_rsu_vehicle_state`, which solves the same contamination geometrically. | Never. Use `--per_rsu_vehicle_state=1` instead. |
| `--gat_or_path_min_phi` | `0.0` | Phi floor before the GAT head OR-path may force a detection. Left at 0.0 because the OR-path itself is disabled via `--gat_det_flag_heads=0`, so there is nothing to floor. | Only meaningful together with `--gat_det_flag_heads=46`. Paper item G4 proposes 0.60; that pairing has NOT been run. |
| `--pop_anomalous_writes` | `false` | ❌ **BROKEN** — Drops the anomalous beacon from kinematic history. Starves the history and drives FPR to 0.535. | Never. Leave at 0. |
| `--lifecycle_gates_fusion` | `false` | AB8 option B: discounts a demoted RSU's psi in fusion. Without it the RSU lifecycle cannot influence MCC/CDER at all (toggling `enable_rsu_lifecycle` alone left both metrics bit-identical). | AB8 only, paired with `--demoted_psi_weight`. Full suppression (weight 0) cost more signal than the poison it blocked: MCC 0.825 -> 0.361. |
| `--cder_credit_cp_detect` | `false` | Credits CP-DETECT's flag_c to CDER so a caught controller compromise stops counting as UNDETECTED control error. Off by default to keep legacy CDER reproducible. | Required if paper item C1 is to be published -- C1 describes behaviour that was OFF in every reported run. |

## Sweep / experiment flags (used only by the named experiment)

| flag | default | belongs to |
|---|---|---|
| `--psi_th` | `0.09` | Composite alert threshold. WARNING: dual role -- it is both the LW alert threshold (`06d_ai_inference.h:1102`) AND the fusion normaliser (`:908`). Sweeping it moves the full-mode decision boundary too. Code default 0.09; the paper's sweep table selects 0.05. |
| `--kappa_th` | `0.1` | MP-S3 KL-divergence threshold. |
| `--delta_th` | `5.0` | TP-S5 drift threshold. Reads vehicle_state, so its calibration is affected by `--per_rsu_vehicle_state`. |
| `--drift_window_k` | `10` | TP-S5 drift observation window, in beacons. Same per-RSU-state coupling as delta_th. |
| `--k_sybil` | `5.0` | MP-S1 Sybil density factor. NOTE: ring_detect now also fires the MP-S1 bit, so this no longer sweeps a single mechanism. |
| `--s_max_kmh` | `-1.0` | TP-S1/MP-S4 DETECTION speed bound, decoupled from --maxspeed and the trace. Also forces a full-mode detection via the hard speed-bound override. |
| `--stealth_fraction` | `0.7` | Experiment 1 secondary axis -- stealth vs abrupt proportion (gamma). |
| `--phi_max` | `1.5707963267948966` | GAT graph heading-divergence bound. Code constant PHI_MAX_GRAPH is pi/2; `tab:fullmode-selected` claims 45 degrees for urban. |
| `--fhe_ring_dim` | `0` | AB7 -- FHE ring dimension N (32768 vs 65536). |
| `--ablation_ab` | `0` | Selects the AB1-AB11 variant by name. |
| `--enable_rule_signatures` | `true` | AB1 -- removes the psi FUSION term. NOTE: sig_mask and psi still feed the GAT input even under AB1, because the GAT consumes 16 features including psi and all nine signature bits. |
| `--enable_hmac_gate` | `true` | AB2 -- HMAC + nonce beacon gate. |
| `--n_coord` | `4` | Experiment 4 / AB3 -- coordinating attacker count. |
| `--streak_sigma` | `-1` | Experiment 4 -- poisoning streak length. |
| `--eps_max` | `0.5` | AB4 / Experiment 4 -- stealth drift cap per beacon. |
| `--lambda_ae` | `-1.0` | AB4 -- rescales the GLOBAL lambda triple only, keeping the psi:gat ratio. Needed because k_hat is -1 on most decisions, so the per-attack sets never apply and the global lambda_ae=0.3071 alone caps the AE's vote below Phi_th. |
| `--lambda_gat` | `-1.0` | AB3 -- rescales the GLOBAL lambda triple only, keeping the psi:ae ratio. JSON on disk untouched. |
| `--poison_theta` | `0.5` | AB4 sweep: attack deviation scale theta in [0,1], default 0.5. Scales max_position_deviation / max_velocity_deviation in PoisonTrajectoryByType(). LOWER = stealthier, so the psi rules and the spatial GAT stop saturating and the LSTM-AE becomes the discriminating tier. Left at its default in the reported runs. |
| `--enable_trs` | `true` | AB6 -- TRS threshold signing gate. |
| `--trs_compromised_f` | `-1` | AB6 f/n sweep -- forces F of n ring members compromised. |
| `--enable_fhe` | `true` | AB7 -- plaintext aggregates, TRS still signs. |
| `--ab7_ring_n` | `-1` | AB7 x-axis, TRS/FHE ring size n. Added but NOT yet built or smoke-tested. |
| `--enable_rsu_lifecycle` | `true` | AB8 -- RSU three-state trust lifecycle. |
| `--enable_sc_trust` | `true` | R3 config 5 -- skips vehicle SC-Trust evidence submission; vehicle trust never decays. |
| `--enable_sc_revoke` | `true` | R3 config 5 -- skips vehicle SC-Revoke vote; vehicles are never revoked. |
| `--rsu_malicious_fraction` | `-1.0` | AB8 f/n sweep, decoupled from attack_percentage. |
| `--ctrl_compromise_onset` | `0.0` | AB9 x-axis -- controller compromise onset as a fraction of simTime. |
| `--rsu_trust_quorum` | `0` | AB8 -- overrides q_i quorum; 2 is reachable at 30 s but weakens BFT. |
| `--t_window` | `-1.0` | AB8 -- overrides SC-Revoke's T_w witness window, which was otherwise hardcoded at 30 s regardless of simTime. That hardcoding is why the 300 s AB8 test showed nothing. |
| `--rsu_t_rev` | `3` | AB8 -- T_rev consecutive low-trust epochs before permanent demotion. |
| `--rsu_trust_alpha` | `0.3` | AB8 -- RSU trust EMA alpha. THIS is the actual client-demotion gate (tau < tau_min = 0.3); T_rev only gates the later revoke escalation. |
| `--demoted_psi_weight` | `0.5` | AB8 option B -- multiplier on a demoted RSU's psi. 0.5 default; 0 (full silence) measured worse than leaving the poison in. |
| `--enable_ctrl_rotation` | `true` | AB9 -- single fixed controller vs the trusted-controller set. |
| `--use_lkh_tree` | `true` | AB11 -- LKH tree vs per-member unicast rekey. |
| `--trs_classical` | `false` | AB7 -- ECDSA-class baseline instead of ML-DSA-87, for the signing-latency comparison. |
| `--tiered_commit` | `true` | Blockchain tiered commit strategy on/off. |
| `--t_batch` | `10.0` | Tier-3 batch commit interval, seconds. Constraint: T_batch << T_w. |
| `--n_commit` | `50` | Tier-3 batch commit threshold, evidence entries. |
